text.tspan: Countries that are long-standing electoral democracies World
Classification by Lührmann et al. (2018) based on expert estimates by V-Dem. Electoral democracies are political
systems that hold meaningful, free and fair, and multi-party elections.

tspan.tspan: The share of closed autocracies increases a lot in 1900 because V-Dem covers many more countries since then, often colonies.
